manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: All-Fates Stalker must be exiled by Faceless Butcher, and Changeling Titan must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Titan for its mana cost.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, All-Fates Stalker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of All-Fates Stalker's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
